name: אַרְוָדִי
summary: The Arvadites, the people of Arvad, one of the Canaanite clans; the definite singular names the people collectively. The gentilic is formed from the place name Arvad, whose own derivation is not given.

evidence.note: The Arvadites appear alongside the Zemarites and Hamathites. The verse calls the groups in the list Canaanite clans.

note: Moved from the former word entry `2arewaadiy` (old root key ארודי, the gentilic noun’s own consonants).
